run.input_contract: FlightSession._physics_process samples the case raw target and calls the real Commands.step_commands slew limiter; FlightSession._inputs adds trims and clamps; Simulation.step applies actual servo/rpm state updates.
run.label: intermediate
run.sample_contract: One row at the initial boundary, then one row after each FlightSession input-shaping call and Simulation.step(). State and loads are both timestamped at that boundary; loads are recomputed from the boundary state/current servo and RPM values, not retained RK4 intermediate stages.
run.wing_strip_api: Aero.wing_strip_loads; local wing strips before global/local blend and excluding tail, propulsion, and gyro.

trace_storage.format: lossless CSV gzip; omitted cases retain per-case summaries and generated trace hashes
